recipes.name: Homemade Quick & Easy Turkey Stock
ingredients: 1 yellow or white onion, roughly chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan, add all ingredients and cover with 6 cups (1.4L) of cold water, or enough to completely cover the bones.
Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. As soon as the stock reaches a boil, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 3 hours.
Skim the broth scum that’s settled at the top of the stock then strain over a fine mesh sieve into a clean pot. Discard the solids and reserve the stock for stuffing.
